audit.why: Chart on disk (Skill, Shen, Shen, Skill, Skill, Shen, Shen) matches the packet chart and the 53.28% over 1096 games; full and content layers already agree row for row.
Four spikes present: Shen Lvl 2-3, Shen Lvl 6 (Stand United 200/180/160s), Swain Lvl 6 (Demonic Ascension, flat 120s), Shen first item. Timings are right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated/misassigned ability names and one absent decisive interaction. (a) early says 'Q Vision of Empire' — Vision of Empire is Swain's W; his Q is Death's Hand. (b) spikes[3] says 'his W Nevermove bomb' — Nevermove is his E. (c) 'Valor Stolen' appears in wants.foe[1] and late as the name of his passive; the passive is Ravenous Flock and the pickups are Soul Fragments. (d) Nevermove (E) can interrupt Shen's Stand United channel and this is never stated.
audit.why: Riot's kit data lists Q Death's Hand (7/6/5/4/3s), W Vision of Empire (22-18s), E Nevermove (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, projectile + hard CC), R Demonic Ascension (flat 120s), P Ravenous Flock. Shen's R is flagged channel/interruptible, and the missing-interactions file flags Nevermove specifically as the cancel.
audit.corrected: Names corrected to Death's Hand, Vision of Empire (W), Nevermove (E) and Ravenous Flock; the R-cancel written into report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d say only 'his drain, trade when it's down' with no numbers.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s at all ranks — an unusually punishable window worth naming. Death's Hand drops to 3s at rank 5, so 'dodge his poke' stops being a plan and closing the gap is.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.late prescribes anti-heal without naming what heals.
audit.why: Missing-interactions flags needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated on Ravenous Flock: Soul Fragments heal Swain and permanently raise his max health, so stacking flat resists alone does not answer him.
audit.corrected: Named the source of the healing.

edits.before: At level 1 Swain pokes with Q Vision of Empire and sits at range — match his pattern with Twilight Assault auto-trades on the blade path and shield up with Ki Barrier, but do not walk into his E Nevermove range without your dash ready. The moment you hit level 2 and pick up Shadow Dash, the dynamic flips: E into him before he can land his own E, force his autos into Spirit's Refuge, and punch through Twilight Assault's blade for the full bonus. He cannot drain what he cannot hit.
edits.after: At level 1 Swain pokes with Q Death's Hand and sits at range — match his pattern with Twilight Assault auto-trades on the blade path and shield up with Ki Barrier, but do not walk into his 850-range E Nevermove without your dash ready. The moment you hit level 2 and pick up Shadow Dash, the dynamic flips: E into him before he can land his own E, force his autos into Spirit's Refuge, and punch through Twilight Assault's blade for the full bonus. He cannot drain what he cannot hit.

edits.before: Sunfire Aegis burning through his W Nevermove bomb window and Hollow Radiance shredding his MR resistance lets you run him down — force the all-in the moment your first item completes.
edits.after: Sunfire Aegis burning through his Vision of Empire (W) zone and Hollow Radiance shredding his MR lets you run him down — force the all-in the moment your first item completes.

edits.before: Stack Valor Stolen soul fragments by draining you through Demonic Ascension's AOE in extended trades
edits.after: Stack Ravenous Flock (P) Soul Fragments by draining you through Demonic Ascension's AOE in extended trades

edits.before: Late game Swain becomes a sustained-AOE teamfight monster — his Demonic Ascension draining multiple targets with his full AP stack is brutal if he gets on top of your backline. Your job is to be the first body he hits: E-taunt him as he pops R so his drain targets you through your Spirit's Refuge zone rather than your carries, buying your team the window to burst him before the stacks pay off. Build Hollow Radiance into Warmog's and the Valor Stolen drain barely dents you while your team deletes him.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain. Trade when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Demonic Ascension: a flat 120s at every rank — that is your whole trading window. - Nevermove: 12s at rank 1, and it cancels your R channel. - Death's Hand: 7s early but 3s at rank 5 — stop dodging poke and close.

edits.before: His drain. Trade when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s. Engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Nevermove cancels your R channel — cast Stand United after his E.

edits.before: Track Swain's Demonic Ascension: His drain. Trade when it’s down. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Nevermove (E, 12s) cancels your Stand United channel — cast R only once his root is spent.
